infobox.location: Streets of Tarkov, Shoreline, Ground Zero

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Job for a Patriot is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "No shortage of patriots... I had a conversation with a group of BEARs the other day, we chatted about domestic weapons. Always nice to meet people who know their stuff!Just got a brand-new Kalashnikov in, and it needs a proper field test... Hmm, maybe somewhere with a mix of urban and open terrain? Yeah, that would be perfect. Here's the build. Go put it through its paces."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 PMCs with AK-12 with proprietary suppressor and PS-320 scope on Streets of Tarkov, Shoreline, or Ground Zero

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Toolset
- Unlocks craft for VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade at Workbench level 2
- 3× VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenade
"Never had a doubt! Here's your reward."

sections.heading: Initial equipment
sections.text:
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Notes |
| AK-12 | Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle | 1 | Modded after task requirements |

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Only the AK-12 5.45x39 sound suppressor can be used. It's possible to use a compact reflex sight mounted on a canted rail instead of the Valday PS-320 1/6x scope to obtain the kills. The scope just needs to be installed to count towards the quest.
